svg.desc: World Bank Headquarters LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2018 15 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Urban Planning & Design Project Overview Full detailed design for the new headquarters concerning architectural, mechanical, and sanitary systems, fire and security systems, telephone/internet systems, interior design drawings, furniture, general and specific specifications, and quantity surveying. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and urban planning & design.
